title: Implement character disarm contested action to wrest visibly held items cleanly without lethal attack

sections.what: Add a non-lethal contested disarm action (disarm <person> [item]) in combat.py and action_verbs.py to wrest visibly held items away without lethal attack damage or covert steal, recording structured disarm turn_events.
sections.why: engine/action_verbs.py (lines 115-117) only exposes attack, grab, and release for combat. Without disarm, a character trying to stop someone brandishing a knife, gun, or phone must either deal lethal damage via player_attack or attempt covert pocket-picking via steal. Furthermore, bug-590 ThreatDetector needs explicit disarm turn_events to distinguish an ally disarming an aggressor from hostile violence.
sections.how:
1. Add player_disarm(attacker_name, target_name, item_name=None) in engine/combat.py resolving an opposed DEX/STR/Athletics check against target's visibly held/equipped item (honoring weapon size, two-handed grip, prone/frightened modifiers, and approach_character).
2. On success, move the item off the defender's equipped hand slot/carry onto the disarmer (if a free hand / requested) or drop it into the current area cleanly via existing equipment/drop helpers, updating weight and firing any unequip triggers.
3. Record a structured 'disarm' turn_event with actor, target, and disarmed item metadata for ThreatDetector (bug-590) and simultaneous round visibility (task-955).
4. Register disarm in engine/action_verbs.py, routes/action_handlers.py (_VERBS_NEEDING_TARGET + dispatcher), PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS, and contextual-actions.ts when another present character visibly holds an item.
sections.verify: 1. Run pytest covering engine/combat.py player_disarm success, failure, free-hand catch vs floor drop, non-lethal HP preservation, and structured turn_event emission.\n2. Run npm run build:ts and node tools/unit/run.cjs verifying PlanGrounding and contextual-actions disarm surfacing.

acceptance.text: disarm is registered in engine/action_verbs.py, PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS, routes/action_handlers.py, and contextual-actions.ts when a co-located character holds a visible item or weapon.

Disarm resolves as an opposed physical contest (Athletics/DEX/STR) against the target's visibly held/equipped hand item without dealing lethal weapon damage, moving the item either to the ground or the disarmer's grip cleanly.
Successful and failed disarm attempts record structured turn_events (actor, action='disarm', target, item, outcome) consumable by ThreatDetector (bug-590) and witness memories.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal Available Actions / People Here context and Event Stream turn log.

Current availability: engine/action_verbs.py exposes attack, grab, and release; no disarm verb exists in engine/combat.py or routes/action_handlers.py.

Manual verification steps:
1. Equip/hold a weapon or item on Character A and run `disarm A` (or `disarm <item> from A`) from Character B.
2. Inspect resulting item possession, HP (no lethal damage), and turn_events.
   - expected: Opposed check runs, weapon moves out of A's hand on success, and structured 'disarm' turn_event records actor, target, and item.
